task_title: Prevent repeated laser hits per firing

plan_review.notes: Approved with changes. Added explicit rewrite of the contradictory repeated-damage test; all beam pipeline/determinism tests to validation because RNG/RunStats can shift; multi-tick skill-XP assertion; proven beamSystem cleanup import pattern; late-entrant test via direct full scan/fresh candidates; both AI primary/additional-target model paths. Retained established add-after-qualifying-attempt semantics; enemy targets cannot dodge player beams, so an artificial zero-damage mutation test would not validate issue #3702.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation correctly uses a WeakMap to track hits per beam EID, clearing it on spawn and expiration to prevent leaks. The AI and DPS calculators were correctly updated to reflect the new 1-hit-per-activation model. Test coverage explicitly asserts the new behavior, including late entrants and subsequent firings. Everything aligns perfectly with existing code patterns (e.g. areaDamageSystem) and repository policies.
